patch_description:
This edit upgrades the signal generator from a mostly threshold-only entry model into a regime-aware, asymmetric decision function that uses the richer bar context already available in the environment.

Key improvements:
- Adds stronger entry filters using order-book imbalance, depth, spread, kyle lambda, RSI, MACD, VWAP deviation, Bollinger position, trend strength, autocorrelation, and funding.
- Separates momentum-trend entries from mean-reversion entries so the model can exploit both continuation and reversion regimes without lookahead.
- Makes thresholds adaptive to volatility and execution cost, reducing low-quality trades when spreads or impact are elevated.
- Uses volatility-adjusted asymmetric exits: long and short trades get different TP/SL multipliers based on regime quality and trend confirmation.
- Scales position size by conviction and liquidity quality instead of a flat size, while keeping bounds conservative to protect win rate and drawdown.
- Tightens time-in-trade in noisy or cost-heavy regimes and allows a little more runway when trend and book quality align.

The goal is to improve combined score by preserving the current high win rate while increasing average trade quality, especially in toxic-flow or choppy conditions.
